portTable: Server wordmark; no routing-hook suspense
Shared navbar.tsx + async marketing-frame.tsx; routing hooks confined to marketing-controls.tsx.
Named mobile navigation and video control
nav-actions.tsx and mobile-menu.tsx retain localized trigger/Sheet names; video-hero.tsx retains the visible watch text in playLabel.
First-use mobile island
nav-actions.tsx loads mobile-menu.tsx only on click; the loaded Sheet opens immediately.
Native desktop dropdown; closed panels hidden
Shared nav-dropdown.tsx uses CSS, click/Escape, hidden panels and no Framer dependency.
Plain SVG icon graph and licence
Shared static-icons.tsx/LICENSE; app reexports the subpath; products/navigation/nav-menu render server-side.
No global query provider
Marketing layout omits QueryProvider; pricing-island.tsx and the contact-local provider retain their own graph.
Trimmed client translations
ROOT_CLIENT_MESSAGE_PATHS retained; marketing-render-context.ts sends only landing/commercialComparison plus shared paths on EN/VI roots. Other routes retain full sets.
Deferred bento/demo/AI/pricing/stats/CTA; hash links
deferred-landing-sections.tsx and HashScroll retained; problem/payoff also wait for viewport proximity.
Immediate hero/reveal and click-to-load video
rise.ts, reveal.tsx, hero/video files retained; video-player.tsx adds matching responsive WebP/preload assets.
Constrained-device motion and timers
Shared use-static-motion.ts; app alias preserves all demo/AI/pricing/count-up/hero consumers and tests. Shared shell disables backdrop blur and dropdown resize motion on constrained devices.
Static paint and manual marquee
landing.css, manual product-marquee.tsx, trust-badge contrast, demo/AI timer guards retained unchanged.
One stylesheet identity
Main's start-bridge page-render.tsx normalization retained unchanged; shared fonts and landing CSS co-located with root globals.css. One stylesheet request, no crossorigin mismatch.
App-scoped CSS graph
marketing-css.mjs includes shared-shell transitive UI imports; scanner test covers them. Vite plugin retained.
Font assets and deleted app files

Duplicate app font setup removed; shared OFL faces retained, mono EN/VI subsets added with full-glyph fallback and small static 400 faces. Deleted navigation gains are all mapped above; no performance gain discarded.

limits: Score >=90 and LCP <2.5s remain unmet; the 84/82 and 3.64/3.79s floor passes. INP proxy <200ms passes.
LCP is the responsive video poster in both locales. Representative simulated render delay is 2.44s EN / 2.70s VI (70% / 75% of LCP); image load itself is about 126 / 135ms.
One 35.6KiB gzip stylesheet blocks for about 1.36s; Lighthouse estimates 450ms savings. The 111KiB gzip framework entry contains about 51KiB unused JS (400ms estimated LCP savings).
Next cut: route-level critical CSS plus progressive Start/RSC resource delivery and framework entry splitting; preserve the fully styled first paint and EN/VI typography.
Production noindex/indexing is outside scope, owned by PR #8178/release policy; protected worker, SEO policy, Void config and native runtime files are unchanged.
